278957590.description:
Vintage Glass Insulator Lot
Hemingray and Various Makers
Aqua, Clear, and Dark Grey, Early-to-Mid 20th Century
A substantial collection of vintage industrial glass insulators, including iconic Hemingray-42 models in classic aqua blue. These insulators were historically used on utility lines to prevent electricity loss. Today, they are prized for their heavy construction and industrial aesthetic.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray-42 aqua blue glass insulators
Clear glass insulators with threaded designs
Dark matte finish insulators, porcelain or composite
Decorative black metal scrollwork hangers
Condition:
Vintage condition with expected industrial wear. Pieces show surface soot and minor fleabites characteristic of utility use. No major structural cracks. Metal shows minor finish wear.
